globalAnalysis.visualFlow: Wind moves through clouds, parasol, veil, and dress above a dense flowered slope; the woman rises while the child remains lower and farther back.
globalAnalysis.curatorialNote: Air and fabric should share flowing motion, while the parasol provides a clear pulse and the meadow adds quick organic detail.

cells.label: Blue sky and brushed cloud
cells.interpretation: Loose cloud strokes move briskly through open blue air.

cells.label: Parasol canopy in the wind
cells.interpretation: The round green canopy tilts and catches the wind as a strong rhythmic shape.

cells.label: Parasol edge and veiled face
cells.interpretation: The shaded face appears beneath the moving edge of the parasol.

cells.label: Open blue air
cells.interpretation: Open blue air gives the figure room to turn into the wind.

cells.label: Bright rolling cloud
cells.interpretation: A luminous cloud rolls gently behind the figures.

cells.label: Parasol handle and lifted arm
cells.interpretation: The narrow handle and lifted hand connect the body to the canopy above.

cells.label: Woman turning in the wind
cells.interpretation: Her turned face and windblown veil form the human focus.

cells.label: Sky beside the dress
cells.interpretation: Open sky brushes against the pale moving silhouette.

cells.label: Child emerging from the slope
cells.interpretation: The smaller distant child rises softly from the horizon.

cells.label: Billowing dress enters the meadow
cells.interpretation: Long pale folds sweep downward as wind pushes the dress across the field.

cells.label: Dress in motion
cells.interpretation: Repeated diagonal folds make the fabric visibly flutter and turn.

cells.label: Luminous air at the silhouette
cells.interpretation: Pale air dissolves the edge of the windblown figure.

cells.label: Child and wildflower edge
cells.interpretation: The child is partially absorbed by the rising meadow texture.

cells.label: Dark windblown grass
cells.interpretation: Dense green strokes lean together under the wind.

cells.label: Feet among yellow flowers
cells.interpretation: The figure meets the flowered field in quick scattered color accents.

cells.label: Meadow trailing out
cells.interpretation: The textured meadow continues beyond the moving figure toward the frame.
